scope: Actual committed shaded articulated renderer and service-worker Cache Storage installed, then replaced through the real update/activate/controller lifecycle by the current flat native sprite release. Reserved isolated QA profile; no activity awards or profile edits.

sourceReference.comparison: Exact committed LF source bytes and raw binary PNG bytes; working-tree CRLF text is not used for hosted comparison.

limits: Chromium/Edge only. This verifies a real returning-browser service worker and Cache Storage upgrade, not every browser engine or CDN.
Old runtime requests are served from committed repository blobs during the baseline phase; API requests continue to the actual backend.
No session values, raw codes or personal details are logged.
Joint samples use one shared physical time across all animations. Automated movement and clothing attachment checks do not replace independent painted-frame anatomy review.
